changelog:
Smart Voiceprint Recognition—on-device, local-only. Ava learns frequent wakeword callers from short samples, publishes who triggered to HA Voiceprint Status sensor. No cloud upload. Lightweight matcher for fixed-wakeword scenario. Path: Settings → Voice Configuration → Smart Voiceprint Recognition. Set User 1 / User 2 names, wake a few times, Ava learns. Automate: Dad wakes → study lights on; Mom wakes → kitchen view; Unknown → skip sensitive panels.

Quick Entity Panel now supports camera entities—doorbell, nursery, garage, pet cams alongside lights and switches. Path: Settings → Extensions → Quick Entity Panel. Wall-mounted glance without full HA page.

Browser Edge Swipe Menu—swipe from browser overlay edge for direct access to Voice Memo, Weather, Clock, Quick Entity, Camera, Mic Mute, Dark Mode. Addresses #77 @janstadt. Path: Settings → Sidebar / Menu Settings; Settings → Browser → Browser Sidebar.

Browser Display fixes: toggle unresponsiveness resolved, show/hide/recovery lifecycle improved, dark mode sync with HA page enhanced, Gecko engine package recovery and state sync hardened, edge cases handled. Browser page zoom entity added, adjustable from HA. Thanks @meiser79 #81, @jancernik #79.

More HA-style XML icons added: awning, Bluetooth, media, scene, timer, store, device warning. Thanks @meiser79 #84.

Wakeup animation fixes: 500ms dual-wakeword delay eliminated, residual effects after pause fixed, animation stops correctly on service stop, edge lighting and ripple improved. Per-wakeword voice feedback color customization added.
